appearance.densityHint: How river cards are laid out on Home.

themeHints.system: Match your OS setting, and switch automatically when it changes.

reading.markScrollHint: An item is marked read once it scrolls above the top of the list.
reading.hideReadHint: Read items leave the river instead of staying dimmed.
reading.keyboardHint: j / k to move between items, Esc to leave the reader.
reading.externalHint: Clicking an item opens its source link instead of the built-in reader.

refreshing.refreshHint: How often Monfil checks your feeds for new items.
refreshing.onLaunchHint: Also refresh once immediately when Monfil starts.
refreshing.keepHint: Remove older articles after this many days. Keep at least 10 per feed.

privacy.unavailable: This build of Monfil does not collect usage stats.
privacy.shareHint: Send one daily count of the features you use. No feed, article, or search text leaves your device. Turn it off at any time to stop sending and delete the counts kept on this device.

diagnostics.detailedHint: Record debug details in the local log file. Feed names, full links, article text, credentials, and file paths are removed.

analyticsCard.label: Anonymous usage stats
analyticsCard.title: Help improve Monfil
analyticsCard.body: Share anonymous usage stats: one daily count of the features you use. No feed, article, or search text leaves your device. You can change this in Settings at any time.

analyticsPreview.title: What is sent
analyticsPreview.body: Monfil sends one summary like this for each day you use it. It holds counts and settings. It holds no feed, article, search text, or name.
